item.title: Bilibili Gaming beat all four LCK teams to win Worlds 2026 and end Korean title run
item.description:
Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G in Brooklyn to win the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, the LPL's first world title since 2021. Added to their First Stand trophy, the result gives a Chinese side a double that no team had managed since 2016, just as Riot takes the 2027 season opener to China.

item.title: Reinstated Aurora Gaming beat F9 EICAR to win Valorant Europe Qualifier 1
item.description:
Aurora Gaming came from a map down to beat F9 EICAR 2-1 and win the first VCT EMEA Kickoff Europe open qualifier. The win came days after they were put back into the bracket when the UK team BONK was disqualified for cheating.

The post Reinstated Aurora Gaming beat F9 EICAR to win Valorant Europe Qualifier 1 appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Aurora Gaming sweep Pixel Lumina to reach Europe Qualifier 1 final after BONK disqualification
item.description:
Aurora Gaming beat Pixel Lumina 2-0 to reach the Europe Qualifier 1 final, days after the UK side that had knocked them out was disqualified for cheating. The final decides seeding for the Europe Qualifier Playoffs, the next step towards VCT EMEA Kickoff 2027 in Berlin.

The post Aurora Gaming sweep Pixel Lumina to reach Europe Qualifier 1 final after BONK disqualification appeared first on Esports Insider.
